name: 鈴鈴清潔車
desc: a cute claymation street-sweeper truck, cream/off-white cab with a bright green lower body, an orange light-bar on the roof, a black cube wake-up speaker with one large circular driver sitting on a small pink rectangular base mounted on the roof behind the light bar, two big round yellow spinning brushes at the front bottom, big friendly round eyes and a cheerful smile

name: 恐龍車多多
desc: a cute claymation green dinosaur car, a small green car body with a friendly T-rex head, orange spikes along its back, big round cartoon eyes, wide happy mouth showing rows of teeth, four black wheels only — no arms, no hands, no limbs

name: 安安救護車
desc: a cute claymation cream-white ambulance van with a red cross on the side, a red light-bar on the roof, a red side stripe, yellow round headlights, big friendly eyes and a gentle smile

name: 小紅賽車
desc: a cute claymation bright red race car with the number 2 in a white circle, a white racing stripe down the middle, blue and yellow accents, big round eyes and a cheerful smile

name: 藍色小巴士
desc: a cute claymation friendly sky-blue minibus with a rounded boxy body, cream lower trim, yellow round headlights, a small side door, big warm eyes and a gentle caring smile

name: 黃色計程車
desc: a cute claymation bright yellow taxi cab with a black-and-white checker stripe along the side, a small taxi sign on the roof, round headlights, big cheerful eyes and a happy smile

name: 怪獸卡車
desc: a cute claymation bright yellow monster truck pickup named Mengmeng (萌萌) with huge chunky black off-road tyres with yellow rims, yellow coil-spring suspension, a black roof bar with four round yellow spotlights, light-blue windshield with big friendly round eyes and a small smile on the bumper, grey textured grille, black roll bar in the truck bed, soft hand-sculpted clay texture

name: 東東挖土機
desc: a cute claymation yellow excavator on black tracks with a digging arm and bucket, big round eyes, rosy cheeks and a happy smile

name: 吊車老爺爺
desc: a wise cute claymation orange crane truck with a long extending boom arm, grey hook at the end, cream cab windows, kind gentle eyes and a warm grandfather smile

name: 小橘高鐵
desc: a cute claymation cream-white Taiwan HSR bullet train with long multi-carriage body on rails, sleek aerodynamic nose with friendly face (big round eyes, pink cheeks, gentle smile), bold orange stripe along the side, dark grey lower body, absolutely NO arms NO hands NO limbs

name: 三輪車
desc: a cute claymation small three-wheeled tricycle with a front cargo basket, colorful body, big round friendly eyes and a smile, personified as a little delivery trike

name: 香香餐車
desc: a cute claymation pink food truck named Xiangxiang with kawaii round face, big sparkling eyes, open side window selling donuts (strawberry pink, chocolate, rainbow sprinkle), roof sign with donut icons, soft hand-sculpted clay texture

name: 沃特
desc: A small, round robot with a polite demeanor, capable of various tasks inside the futuristic car.

name: Bonbon
desc: a cute claymation boy host named Bonbon (阿蹦), thick messy brown clay hair, big cheerful dark eyes with rosy cheeks, light teal long-sleeve hoodie, navy blue shorts, bright red sneakers with white laces and white socks, bright yellow backpack, energetic curious open smile, soft hand-sculpted clay texture

name: 馬米
desc: a cute claymation adult woman host named Mami (馬米), long voluminous wavy dark brown hair, warm friendly smile with big dark eyes, light pink long-sleeve top, coral pink knee-length skirt, pink high-heeled pumps, small pink stud earrings, gentle welcoming host energy, soft hand-sculpted clay texture

name: 小飛
desc: a cute claymation personified drone named Xiao Fei, cream off-white rounded square clay body, yellow lightning bolt on forehead, big glossy black eyes, pink cheek blush, wide happy smile, black camera lens on lower face, two small green LED lights, four gray arms with spinning propellers, no legs

name: 小南
desc: a cute claymation Taipei MRT train with a sleek silver-white body, blue and green stripes along the side, big round friendly eyes, pink cheeks and a warm welcoming smile

name: 高高摩天輪
desc: a cute claymation Ferris wheel named Gaogao (高高) with yellow-and-blue frame, a friendly yellow circular hub face with big round eyes pink cheeks and a warm smile, eight colorful round gondolas (pink orange yellow green light blue dark blue purple) each with a tiny heart, a string of colorful bulbs along the rim, pink-purple base platform with yellow star emblem, soft hand-sculpted clay texture

name: 小柔露營車
desc: a cute claymation small pink camper van named Xiaorou (小柔) with a rounded cozy body, cream-tinted windows, a tiny striped awning, gentle big round eyes with rosy cheeks and a soft warm smile, compact and calm feminine energy

name: 小衝賽車
desc: a cute claymation bright yellow race car named Xiaochong (小衝) with two bold black racing stripes on the hood, black tinted windows, a small rear spoiler, black wheels, impatient energetic eyes and a pouty speedy expression, sleek and distinct from red race car number 2

name: 亮亮警車
desc: a cute claymation police car named Liangliang (亮亮), compact rounded dark navy-blue and white body, windshield forms friendly big round eyes and small curved smile, red-blue light bar on roof, white doors with bold yellow six-pointed police star, gray front bumper with white license plate reading 110, small black side mirrors, soft hand-sculpted clay texture, distinct from sky-blue minibus

name: 阿酷鑽地車
desc: a cute claymation yellow drill excavator named Aku (阿酷) on black crawler tracks, hydraulic arm with a large dark spiral drill bit instead of a bucket, stern cool expression with thick black eyebrows and focused round eyes (rarely smiling), a small pink frosted donut hanging from a side hook, soft hand-sculpted clay texture, distinct from cheerful yellow bucket excavator Dongdong (東東挖土機)
